dedupe_keys.name: city of austin issued construction permits building electrical mechanical plumbing

description: The City of Austin publishes the building, electrical, mechanical, plumbing and driveway or sidewalk permits it issues as an open dataset compliant with the Building and Land Development Specification (BLDS). It held 2,377,482 rows with issue dates from 1921 to 24 September 2026 when read, and 78 columns: permit type, class and work class, project name and description, applied, issued, status, expiry and completion dates, existing, remodel and new floor areas, number of floors, housing units, job and trade valuations, address, council district and jurisdiction, coordinates, travis county parcel ID, contractor and applicant details, certificate of occupancy and lot size. Coverage: City of Austin and its jurisdiction. Access: free CSV and API. Licence: public domain under the City's open data terms. Caveats: Development Services warns that data are for information only, may differ from official figures and change as the database is updated; old records are sparse. Simulation uses: tracking new construction, renovations and electrification work (such as heat pump or solar permits) to update building stock and grid load models. Related records: the San Diego development permits, NYC DOB permit issuance and the Census Building Permits Survey.
